pageDescription: Use shadows to show that a surface sits above another surface, or that a control is active. Do not add a shadow solely to make a component more prominent.
footnote: Note: Components may have their own shadow tokens. Refer to each component’s token and state guidelines

rows.description: Subtle separation for raised cards or small surfaces that need more definition than a border alone.
The most intense element shadow, for example on general components like Floatbutton, Dropdown, Cascader Menu, etc.
The smoothest element shadow, for example on components like Action Panels, Login and Signup Forms.
